sections.title: Aerospace Engineering Document Automation (Boeing)
sections.description: For Boeing Commercial Airplanes (Renton and Everett) and the Puget Sound aerospace supply chain.

blocks.heading: Supplier documentation processing
paragraphs: AI processing the engineering documentation from Boeing's thousands of aerospace suppliers — extracting qualification data from AS9100 certificates, dimensional data from first-article inspection reports, and compliance data from material test reports for Boeing's enormous supplier quality management operation. The documentation volume of a 737 or 787 program's supply chain runs to millions of documents over a program's lifecycle.

blocks.heading: Engineering change order automation
paragraphs: AI processing Boeing's complex engineering change documentation — extracting scope, affected parts, implementation requirements, and testing obligations from engineering change orders for the quality and manufacturing teams implementing changes across Boeing's large production programs.

blocks.heading: Customer service bulletin automation
paragraphs: AI for organizing and extracting key information from Boeing's customer service bulletins for the airline customers managing the technical compliance of their Boeing fleets.

sections.title: Healthcare Revenue Cycle Automation
sections.description: For UW Medicine, Providence Health, and Seattle's health systems.

blocks.heading: Washington payer prior authorization
paragraphs: AI assembling and submitting prior authorization for Washington's commercial payer community (Premera Blue Cross, Regence BlueShield, Kaiser WA, UnitedHealth WA) and Apple Health (Washington's Medicaid) for UW Medicine's and Providence's large Washington patient base.

blocks.heading: WA MHMD Act-compliant health automation
paragraphs: Healthcare automation in Washington that processes consumer health data must comply with Washington's My Health MY Data Act beyond HIPAA — ClickMasters designs Seattle healthcare automation with WA MHMD Act compliance.

blocks.heading: Clinical documentation for coding
paragraphs: AI supporting clinical documentation improvement and coding accuracy for Seattle's academic medical centers — IPPS DRG optimization for the complex cases at UW Medicine's and Swedish Medical Center's large inpatient operations.
